title: Μουσική
description: Ten short stories about music in the first-century Greek East: a widow's kithara at a drinking party, a grandmother's lullaby, a veteran's marching song, a teacher's funeral, a winnowing song, a singing contest in Ephesus, a boys' choir sent to Claros, an apprentice lyre-maker's letter, a boy calmed by music and a kithara singer falsely accused.

lessons.title: Ἡ κιθάρα ἐν τοῖς συμποσίοις
lessons.summary: In Corinth the widow Euterpe, whose kithara is her only livelihood, sings at the young Kallidemos's drinking party; the noisy guests fall silent at her song, sing a drinking song with her and pay her well.

lessons.title: Ἡ ᾠδὴ τῆς νυκτός
lessons.summary: In Thessalonica young Aglais falls into a fever after giving birth; through the night her mother Habrotone swaddles the baby and sings an old lullaby, and at dawn the fever breaks, as the physician foretold.

lessons.title: Ἡ ᾠδὴ τῶν στρατιωτῶν
lessons.summary: In Antioch the old veteran Bassos sits by the fire with his grandson Nikippos and tells him how, on a winter campaign in the mountains, his fellow soldier Proklos made up the marching song he still sings.

lessons.title: Ἡ τελευταία ᾠδὴ τοῦ Φιλάμμωνος
lessons.summary: In Assos the old kithara teacher Philammon dies; his former pupil Sosinikos gathers all his pupils, and instead of hired mourners they sing their teacher's songs at the pyre by the sea and lay his ashes in the tomb of his forefathers.

lessons.title: Ἡ ᾠδὴ τοῦ πτύου
lessons.summary: Near Beroea a red-haired beggar comes to the farmer Astymachos's threshing floor while the workers winnow; he takes up a shovel, leads the winnowing song so well that the work goes faster, and is given wheat, a place by the garden beds and work until spring.

lessons.title: Ὁ ἀγὼν τῶν κιθαρῳδῶν
lessons.summary: At the festival of Artemis in Ephesus the young kithara singer Leontichos, prepared by his teacher Androkritos, stays calm while a rash rival runs on stage too early, and wins the promised golden crown set with a carnelian.

lessons.title: Οἱ παῖδες ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ
lessons.summary: The council of Paros sends ten boys to sing at Apollo's festival on Claros with the envoy Menexenos and the chorus master Philochoros; a sudden storm frightens them on the way, the sailors shorten sail, the boys sing on the prow, and the next day their song is the most admired.

lessons.title: Ἐπιστολὴ ἐκ Περγάμου
lessons.summary: In a letter home to his father in Tarsus, young Alexon tells how he is learning to build a kithara in Pergamon from the master Archebios: fitting the wood together, joining the two horns, removing a stain, and finishing the instrument his master had begun.

lessons.title: Ἡ ἀπόκρισις τῆς προφήτιδος
lessons.summary: In Corinth young Herophilos suffers from the falling sickness; his mother Praxithea takes him to Delphi, where the prophetess tells her to teach him the kithara, and over the next year the music calms him and his fits grow rare.

lessons.title: Ὁ πράκτωρ καὶ ἡ κιθάρα
lessons.summary: In Philippi the kithara singer Biton plays at the wedding of Agathoboulos's daughter; a drunken steward breaks a jar of wine and blames him, the bailiff comes to take his kithara, and before the magistrate the truth comes out and the steward confesses his false charge.
